57	function daysBetween(dateA: string, dateB: string): number {

70	export function computeStreaks(
71	  timestamps: string[],
72	  conv: TimezoneConverter,
73	): { currentStreak: number; streak: number } {
74	  if (timestamps.length === 0) return { currentStreak: 0, streak: 0 }
75	
76	  const datesWithActivity = new Set(timestamps.map((ts) => conv.toDate(new Date(ts))))
77	
78	  const today = conv.toDate(new Date())
79	  let currentStreak = 0
80	  let checkDate = today
81	
82	  if (!datesWithActivity.has(checkDate)) {
83	    checkDate = addDays(checkDate, -1)
84	  }
85	
86	  while (datesWithActivity.has(checkDate)) {
87	    currentStreak++
88	    checkDate = addDays(checkDate, -1)
89	  }
90	
91	  const sortedDates = Array.from(datesWithActivity).sort()
92	  let streak = 0
93	  let run = 0
94	  let prev: string | null = null
95	
96	  for (const date of sortedDates) {
97	    run = prev !== null && daysBetween(prev, date) === 1 ? run + 1 : 1
98	    if (run > streak) streak = run
99	    prev = date
100	  }
101	
102	  return { currentStreak, streak }
103	}

131	  conv: TimezoneConverter,
132	): DailyContribution[] {
133	  const byDate = new Map<string, Record<AgentId, number>>()
134	
135	  for (const cp of checkpoints) {
136	    if (!cp.commit_date) continue
137	    const date = conv.toDate(new Date(cp.commit_date))
138	    let agents = byDate.get(date)
139	    if (!agents) {
140	      agents = emptyAgentContributions()
141	      byDate.set(date, agents)
142	    }
143	    agents[getAgentId(cp.agent)] += cp.steps || 1
144	  }

147	    a.date.localeCompare(b.date),

168	      byKey.set(key, entry)

170	    entry.value += cp.steps || 1
171	  }
172	
173	  return Array.from(byKey.values()).sort((a, b) => {
174	    const d = a.date.localeCompare(b.date)

39	
40	  const datesWithActivity = new Set(timestamps.map((ts) => toLocalDateString(ts)))
41	
42	  // Current streak (from today or yesterday backwards)
43	  const today = new Date()
44	  let currentStreak = 0

46
